findings.rationale: Found at head 58ffa9a and fixed at this reviewed head by commit 12a66fc4331551342d403c3e295954fa6e00b5ed, which rejects unknown keys at node, edge, state, and revision-document level and adds the focused rejection tests. Verified at head 12a66fc: the same probe documents that previously produced the identical revision sha256:f4dd35b6...98 now raise deterministic TypeErrors, while the well-formed document still produces that exact digest, proving the repair closes the identity-collision class without changing legitimate canonical identity.

Nested ternary in compareText violated the resolved OCR TypeScript rule group at head 58ffa9a; commit 12a66fc4331551342d403c3e295954fa6e00b5ed rewrites it as explicit branches with identical behaviour, verified by the unchanged revision digest and the passing focused suite at head 12a66fc.

The O(nodes x edges) outgoing-edge index is a scaling cost, not a correctness defect, and ADR-0003 explicitly defers large-graph performance until workload evidence exists. Carried forward as a P02-S02 query-hardening candidate rather than widening SG-000019 beyond its declared scope.

Cyclic or pathologically deep programmatic input yields a RangeError instead of the contract TypeError. The canonical read path is JSON.parse output, which cannot be cyclic, so the failure mode is unreachable from persisted documents; carried forward as a hardening candidate with a fixture test.
